correctness.rationale: Explicit singleton-descendant enumeration is exhaustive over weight-two supports and one grain overwrite; it forces the n upper bound and all equality supports. The exceptional r=2 and j=3 possibilities are excluded by explicit triple-output collisions. All remaining constructed balls are disjoint because their singleton sets and categorized triple outputs are distinct. Direct exhaustive conflict-graph checks through n=10 and construction checks through n=512 confirm, but do not substitute for, the all-n proof.

value.rationale: The weight-two shell is a canonical sparse constant-composition input constraint for one-grain overwrite correction. The result provides an exact all-blocklength code size and a complete parameterization/count of every optimal indexed codebook, exposing which overwrite collisions control sparse-code design. It is structural and infinite-family, not a short table, routine Hamming deduction, or downstream speculation.
